topicName: What is the purpose of the @Transactional annotation in JPA? How does transaction management work?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is the purpose of the @Transactional annotation in JPA? How does transaction management work?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"The @Transactional annotation in JPA (Java Persistence API) is used to define the scope of a single database transaction. It ensures that a series of operations are treated as one atomic unit, meaning either all operations succeed, or none do. Transaction management involves starting, committing, or rolling back transactions to maintain data integrity."}]
